metadata.description: The data payload to validate (typically a JSON object). Validated against the supplied JSON Schema; defaults are applied and, when strip_unknown is true, undeclared properties are removed.

JSON Schema to validate against. May be a parsed object, a JSON string, a YAML string, or a JavaScript/JSON5-style object literal (unquoted keys, single quotes, trailing commas, // and /* */ comments). If not provided, a permissive object schema is used.
Optional mapping applied to top-level keys of the data before validation (e.g., {'open_ended': 'openEnded'}). Useful when upstream systems use different naming conventions.
If true (default), properties not declared in the schema are dropped when additionalProperties is false, instead of raising an error.
If true, enables debug logging at each processing step. Defaults to false.
Optional dictionary of environment variable overrides to apply at runtime.
